_about: Why Wilson cards on every product page (/p/<MODEL>), in the band near the bottom (Andrew 11/19). One shows at random on each visit, never the same one twice in a row in a tab; 'Another reason' steps through the rest. Edit freely: title and body are plain text; a link is optional (label + an https://, tel:, sms: or /page address). Keep the Google numbers current. Up to 12 cards.

cards.title: Rated 4.9 on Google.
cards.body: More than 1,200 reviews from the homeowners and builders we serve. We'd love to earn your business, too.

cards.title: A showroom you can cook in.
cards.body: Working kitchens, not boxes on shelves. Come to Dripping Springs to see the finishes in person and watch a range do what it does before it comes home with you.

cards.title: Delivered by our own team.
cards.body: Wilson Appliance's own crew brings it in, sets it in place and can haul away the one it replaces. Not a freight line and not a contractor: the same company that sold it to you.

cards.title: We install it ourselves.
cards.body: Wilson installers, not subcontractors. The crew that connects your appliance answers to the same roof that sold it, and treats your home like their reputation depends on it. It does.

cards.title: We service what we sell.
cards.body: Our own factory-authorized technicians look after it for years to come. When you need us, you reach Wilson. Not a call center, and never simply "call the manufacturer."

cards.title: Consultants, not clerks.
cards.body: Our team brings decades of appliance experience, and listening to the details and helping you select the perfect appliance you can use for years to come.

cards.title: The whole kitchen, under one roof.
cards.body: Appliances, cabinetry, countertops, installation and repair. One team that stands behind the whole kitchen, from the first walkthrough to years after.

cards.title: Shop local. It matters.
cards.body: Wilson is a locally owned Dripping Springs business. Your purchase keeps neighbors working, and puts a team you can visit, call or text behind everything you buy.
